name: Claude Code Workspace
description: Full dev environment with Claude CLI, Node, Python, Go, Rust, PHP, and common tools. Mount your project and start coding with AI.
icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="4 17 10 11 4 5"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="20" y2="19"/></svg>
notes:
Mount your project directory as a volume (e.g., /home/user/myproject:/workspace).

The `claude-workspace-home:/home/dev` named volume persists your `claude login` and any self-updates across container restarts. Keep it a NAMED volume — a bind mount over /home/dev would hide the bundled tools.

Open a terminal into the container and run `claude` to start. You can either:
- Run `claude login` to authenticate with your Anthropic account (no API key needed)
- Or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an environment variable

Includes: Node 20, Python 3, Go, Rust, PHP 8, Claude CLI, TypeScript, pnpm, Docker CLI, GitHub CLI. Runs as non-root user `dev`.

name: WordPress + MySQL
description: Full WordPress blog with MySQL database. Multi-service compose stack.
icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M2 12h20"/><path d="M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg>
notes: WordPress at http://localhost:8080. Database password is auto-generated.
compose_yaml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  wordpress:
    image: wordpress:latest
    ports:
      - '8080:80'
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: changeme
    depends_on:
      - db
    restart: unless-stopped
  db:
    image: mysql:8
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: changeme
      MYSQL_DATABASE: wordpress
    volumes:
      - wp-db:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  wp-db:

name: Gitea + PostgreSQL
description: Lightweight Git hosting with PostgreSQL backend. Multi-service compose stack.
icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17 8h1a4 4 0 1 1 0 8h-1"/><path d="M3 8h14v9a4 4 0 0 1-4 4H7a4 4 0 0 1-4-4V8z"/><line x1="6" y1="2" x2="6" y2="4"/><line x1="10" y1="2" x2="10" y2="4"/><line x1="14" y1="2" x2="14" y2="4"/></svg>
notes: Gitea at http://localhost:3000, SSH on port 2222. Database password is auto-generated.
compose_yaml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    ports:
      - '3000:3000'
      - '2222:22'
    environment:
      GITEA__database__DB_TYPE: postgres
      GITEA__database__HOST: db:5432
      GITEA__database__NAME: gitea
      GITEA__database__USER: gitea
      GITEA__database__PASSWD: changeme
    depends_on:
      - db
    volumes:
      - gitea-data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: gitea
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: changeme
      POSTGRES_DB: gitea
    volumes:
      - gitea-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  gitea-data:
  gitea-db:

name: Webmail + Stalwart Mail Server
description: Complete self-hosted email: modern webmail client with Stalwart mail server, PostgreSQL, and Valkey. One-click email infrastructure.
icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 4h16c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v12c0 1.1-.9 2-2 2H4c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V6c0-1.1.9-2 2-2z"/><polyline points="22,6 12,13 2,6"/></svg>
compose_yaml:
services:
  stalwart:
    image: stalwartlabs/mail-server:latest
    ports:
      - '8080:8080'
      - '25:25'
      - '587:587'
      - '465:465'
      - '143:143'
      - '993:993'
      - '4190:4190'
    volumes:
      - stalwart_data:/opt/stalwart-mail
    restart: unless-stopped

  webmail:
    image: ghcr.io/massive-hosting/webmail:latest
    ports:
      - '8095:8095'
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      STALWART_URL: http://stalwart:8080
      WEBMAIL_DATABASE_URL: postgres://webmail:changeme@postgres:5432/webmail?sslmode=disable
      VALKEY_URL: redis://valkey:6379/0
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      valkey:
        condition: service_started
      stalwart:
        condition: service_started
    restart: unless-stopped

  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: webmail
      POSTGRES_USER: webmail
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: changeme
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U webmail']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  valkey:
    image: valkey/valkey:8-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  stalwart_data:
  pgdata:

steps.title: Wait for services to start
steps.description: The stack is starting 4 services: Stalwart mail server, Webmail, PostgreSQL, and Valkey. This typically takes 15-30 seconds.

steps.title: Open Stalwart Admin UI
steps.description: The Stalwart mail server admin panel lets you create domains and email accounts.

steps.title: Get the admin password
steps.description: The default admin password is printed in the Stalwart container logs on first start. Click View Logs and look for a line containing the admin password.

steps.title: Log in and configure Stalwart
steps.description: In the Stalwart admin UI, log in with username 'admin' and the password from the logs. Then go to Management → Directory → Accounts to create email accounts (e.g. you@example.com).

steps.title: Set the admin token
steps.description: In Stalwart admin UI, go to Settings → Authentication → Fallback Admin Secret and copy the token. Paste it below so the webmail can authenticate with Stalwart.
steps.label: Paste the Stalwart admin token here

steps.title: Restart the webmail service
steps.description: The webmail needs to be restarted to pick up the admin token from the .env file.

steps.title: Open Webmail
steps.description: Sign in with the email account you created in Stalwart (e.g. you@example.com).
